application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: fire on P-9504 during a statutory inspection

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-9504 and M-9504 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-9504 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 22 January 2015 an incident occurred on P-9504 and M-9504 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a statutory inspection, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
